project_type: Ruby on Rails monolith with React/Redux frontend, Node.js streaming server
build_system: Rails with Bundler for backend, Yarn/Webpack for frontend
test_framework: RSpec with Fabrication factories for backend, Jest for frontend
build_command: bundle exec rails assets:precompile (full) or just syntax check with bundle exec rubocop for Ruby
test_command: bundle exec rspec spec/models/occm_group* spec/services/*occm* spec/requests/api/v1/occm_groups*
verification_instructions: 1. Run bundle exec rails db:migrate to verify migrations. 2. Run bundle exec rspec for relevant specs. 3. Check frontend compiles with yarn build.
setup_instructions: 1. bundle install 2. yarn install 3. bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Ruby 3.4.4 available via mise. Node.js v22 available via nvm. PostgreSQL needed for migration testing but may not be available - use AST validation instead.
contribution_requirements: All identifiers use occm_ prefix. i18n in both en and ko. Follow existing patterns from Lists feature. Use active_model_serializers for JSON. Use Pundit for authorization. Use Fabrication gem for test factories.
key_patterns: Controllers: inherit Api::BaseController, use doorkeeper_authorize!, require_user!, before_action pattern. Services: inherit BaseService, define call method. Models: include Paginable, use enum with prefix. Serializers: inherit ActiveModel::Serializer, convert id to string. Frontend: Redux with ImmutableMap, api module pattern from api/lists.ts, streaming from actions/streaming.js connectTimelineStream pattern. Streaming server: channelNameFromPath + channelNameToIds + authorizeListAccess pattern in streaming/index.js.
directory_structure: app/models/ - ActiveRecord models. app/controllers/api/v1/ - API controllers. app/services/ - Business logic services. app/serializers/rest/ - JSON serializers. app/policies/ - Pundit policies. app/workers/ - Sidekiq workers. config/routes/api.rb - API routes. config/initializers/doorkeeper.rb - OAuth scopes. config/locales/ - Backend i18n (en.yml, ko.yml). streaming/index.js - Node.js streaming server. app/javascript/mastodon/ - Frontend React app. app/javascript/mastodon/api/ - API client modules. app/javascript/mastodon/actions/ - Redux actions. app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/ - Redux reducers. app/javascript/mastodon/features/ - React components (by feature). app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ - Frontend i18n (en.json, ko.json). db/migrate/ - Rails migrations. spec/ - RSpec tests.
